guideContent.strategyOverview: Gandalf, Party Guest free-casts an instant or sorcery from your hand at the start of each of your combats, with mana value up to twice your legendary Wizard count — and he counts himself. Eighteen cheap legendary Wizards keep that X climbing: two extra Wizards unlock a free Sublime Epiphany, three unlock Jeskai Revelation. Every free cast still counts as casting, so the magecraft shell (Storm-Kiln Artist, Archmage Emeritus, Deekah) and the prowess legends (Adeliz, Balmor) convert each spell into mana, cards, and damage. The deck closes with compact two-card combos — Dualcaster Mage + Twinflame makes infinite hasty attackers, Naru Meha loops any blink spell for infinite magecraft triggers — found by a five-tutor suite and protected by free counters. Five cost reducers keep the plan running honestly if Gandalf is locked down.

deckCategories.name: Commander Engine
deckCategories.description: Gandalf free-casts one instant or sorcery per combat at MV up to 2x your legendary Wizards. Wizard's Staff doubles his trigger; the free spell is cast, so every cast-trigger in the deck fires. Whirlwind of Thought turns every noncreature cast — including Gandalf's free ones — into a card.

deckCategories.name: The Wizard Council
deckCategories.description: Eighteen legendary Wizards, most at three mana or less, each raising Gandalf's X by two while doing real work: cost reduction (Baral, Stenn, Kaza, Vadrik, Mizzix), card flow (Raff, Azami — tap an untapped Wizard to draw), and pressure (Adeliz, Balmor, Vivi, and Gandalf, Goblins' Bane — one damage to each opponent per noncreature spell).

deckCategories.name: Free-Cast Payoffs
deckCategories.description: Marquee spells Gandalf casts for free once the council assembles: Jeskai Revelation at X=7 (four Wizards), Austere Command and Sublime Epiphany at X=6 (three Wizards). Austere Command off the trigger is a free asymmetric wipe — pick the two modes that miss your own board. Call Forth the Tempest rides the free cast at X=8, its double cascade intact. Narset's Reversal is the floor of the package: at mana value 2 it is free in every Gandalf combat, and it triggers magecraft twice — once for the cast, once for the copy it creates.

deckCategories.name: Combo Package
deckCategories.description: Two-card kills and the loops behind them. Dualcaster + Twinflame swings the same turn; Naru Meha loops Ghostly Flicker or Displace for infinite magecraft; Fury Storm goes infinite with any magecraft payoff after one commander re-cast. Sakashima of a Thousand Faces adds redundancy: it enters as a copy of Naru Meha or Dualcaster for a second combo body, or copies Gandalf for a second free cast each combat, and the legend rule does not apply to your permanents so the copy stays.

deckCategories.name: Tutors & Selection
deckCategories.description: Five tutors find the kill: Mystical Tutor and Solve the Equation fetch Twinflame or any combo spell, Merchant Scroll finds the blue instants, Step Through wizardcycles for either combo starter, and Muddle the Mixture transmutes for Twinflame at MV 2.

deckCategories.name: Draw Engines
deckCategories.description: Three engines close the card-draw gap (swap round 3). Mystic Remora taxes every opponent noncreature spell from turn 1 — strongest in the turn 1–4 combo-assembly window, then sacrifices itself to cumulative upkeep. The One Ring is an indestructible legendary artifact (22nd legend for Mox Amber): protection from everything on cast shields the combo turn, then it draws 1, 2, 3... cards per turn for escalating life. Archmage of Runes draws on every instant or sorcery we cast — Gandalf's free cast included, doubled by Harmonic Prodigy — and discounts each one by {1}.

deckCategories.name: Interaction & Protection
deckCategories.description: Four counterspells (Mana Sculpt refunds the countered spell's mana with a Wizard out; Fierce Guardianship and Muddle's counter mode are free on the combo turn), spot removal on every relevant permanent type — including the artifact/enchantment hosers that target this deck — two wipes (Olórin's Searing Light and the opponent-only Call Forth the Tempest), and Clever Concealment phasing the whole board out of danger. Guardian of Faith flashes in to phase the council out of a wipe, and Sevinne's Reclamation rebuys any fallen MV-3-or-less piece — combo starters included — twice thanks to flashback.

deckCategories.name: Mana Engine
deckCategories.description: Six rocks headlined by Mox Amber (22 legends keep it live), on a 38-land base tuned to the 55U/23R/13W pip census. Reflecting Pool taps for any color a land you control could make, Training Center enters untapped in the four-player pod and fixes the U/R core, and Spire of Industry taps for any color off the artifact suite. Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire sits in a Plains slot: the same untapped W source, plus a channel mode that deals 4 damage to an attacking or blocking creature — with 18 other legendary creatures in the 99 it usually costs just {W} and a discard, at instant speed and uncounterable.

synergies.title: Gandalf's X — every legendary Wizard is +2 mana value
synergies.description: Gandalf counts himself, so X starts at 2. Each cheap legend adds 2: with two others he free-casts Sublime Epiphany (MV 6); with three, Jeskai Revelation (MV 7). Eighteen legendary Wizards plus draw density keep the count climbing every turn.

sources.name: DEC-472 census + hypergeometric draw model (comment e2794449)

synergies.title: Wizard's Staff doubles Gandalf's free cast
synergies.description: The Staff's second ability makes a triggered ability of the equipped creature trigger an additional time — on Gandalf that is two free instants or sorceries every combat. Equip Wizard costs a single generic mana.

synergies.title: Dualcaster + Twinflame — the 2-card, 5-mana kill
synergies.description: Cast Twinflame on any creature you control and flash in Dualcaster holding priority; its copy targets Dualcaster itself and each token repeats the loop. Infinite hasty 2/2 attackers that swing the same turn — no payoff needed, and only 3 mana when Gandalf free-casts Twinflame at combat.

synergies.title: Naru Meha loops any blink spell
synergies.description: Flash Naru in response to your own spell; her enters trigger copies it. Flicker or Displace returns Naru's trigger every loop for infinite magecraft; Sublime Epiphany's bounce mode does the same. Hold Naru in hand — her trigger only fires on entry, so a pre-cast body cannot start the loop.

synergies.title: Trigger doublers multiply the spell engine
synergies.description: Veyran doubles your own cast-triggers; Harmonic Prodigy doubles every Wizard's triggered abilities, including Gandalf's combat trigger. Stacked with the magecraft shell, each spell pays out two Treasures, two cards, or two pumps.

synergies.title: Call Forth the Tempest rides the free cast
synergies.description: With four legendary Wizards out, Gandalf's X reaches 8 and casts the Tempest free at combat. It is still a cast, so both cascade triggers fire — two extra free spells — and every spell that turn (free casts included, at their full mana value) grows the sweep. The damage hits only opponents' creatures; the council and the magecraft shell survive.

synergies.title: Mox Amber is live off 21 legends

winConditions.title: Dualcaster Mage + Twinflame
winConditions.description: Cast Twinflame targeting a creature you control; holding priority, flash in Dualcaster Mage. Its enters trigger copies Twinflame targeting Dualcaster; the hasty token copy re-copies the original. Infinite hasty 2/2 attackers swing the same turn — Dualcaster is not legendary, so the tokens all survive. Only 3 mana when Gandalf free-casts Twinflame at combat.

winConditions.title: Naru Meha + Ghostly Flicker / Displace
winConditions.description: With Naru Meha in hand, cast Flicker or Displace on any two permanents, flash in Naru in response; her trigger copies the blink spell targeting Naru plus a land, restarting her trigger each loop. Infinite casts convert through any magecraft payoff: Storm-Kiln (infinite Treasure), Archmage (draw the deck), Deekah (infinite Fractals). Never pre-cast Naru — the trigger only fires on entry.

winConditions.title: Fury Storm + magecraft payoff
winConditions.description: With one prior commander re-cast, Fury Storm's cast trigger copies it; pointing copies at each other with Storm-Kiln out nets Treasure per iteration — infinite Treasure, then infinite draw or Fractals through the other payoffs.
